source: 806 Expressing Goodwill
target: 806: Expressio Benevolentiae

source: 806 Expressing Goodwill
target: 806: Expressio Benevolentiae

source: Amandina? If it were anyone else, Franca might not have remembered, but she couldn’t forget this participant of the Dream Festival, a girl who called the Underworld Daoist her teacher.
target: Amandina? Si quis alius esset, Franca fortasse non meminisset, sed hanc participantem Festi Somniorum oblivisci non potuit, puellam quae Daoistae Inferorum ut magistrum suum appellabat.

source: Franca later summoned the Armored Shadow Chen Tu for more information, and she might even need Amandina’s help.
target: Franca postea “Armored Shadow Chen Tu” ad plura cognoscenda evocavit, atque fortasse etiam Amandinae auxilium opus esse putavit.

source: With this in mind, Franca reached into her Traveler’s Bag and counted her accumulated gold.
target: Hoc mente servato, Franca manum in marsupio viatoris suo inseruit et aurum cumulatum numeravit.

source: Including the final payment from a member of the Curly-Haired Baboon Research Society, she now had gold worth 82,000 verl d’or and nearly 20,000 verl d’or in cash.
target: Incluso solutione finali a membro Societatis Inquisitionis Papionum Crispis Capillis, nunc habebat aurum valoris 82,000 verl d’or et fere 20,000 verl d’or in nummis.

source: With a little exchange, it would be enough to meet the requirements of the Armored Shadow, Chen Tu, for a conversation.
target: Parvo commercio, satis erit ut requisita “Armored Shadow Chen Tu” ad colloquium obtemperanda assequantur.

source: Of course, Franca didn’t plan to do this anytime soon.
target: Certe, Franca non statuit haec cito agere.

source: First, Lumian was in Morora.
target: Primum, Lumian in Morora aderat.

source: Without using his special connection with the contract target, even knowing the Armored Shadow’s name as Chen Tu, Franca wasn’t sure she could summon the spirit from the original world.
target: Non utens speciali nexu suo cum proposito contractus, etiam si “Armored Shadow” sub nomine Chen Tu notum esset, Franca non certo sciebat se posse spiritum ex mundo originali evocare.

source: After all, that might not be its true name, and translating it into ancient Hermes or other mystical languages might correspond to different spirit world creatures.
target: Nam fortasse id verum nomen non esset, et transferre illud in antiquam linguam, ut hypocrisinam aut alias mysticas, diversis creaturis ex mundo spirituum convenire posset.

source: Secondly, facing the Armored Shadow without a demigod present would likely be extremely dangerous.
target: Secundo, adversari “Armored Shadow” sine semideo praesentis valde periculosum esse videbatur.

source: Amandina’s presence might partially substitute for a demigod, intimidating the Armored Shadow.
target: Praesentia Amandinae partim semideum substituere potuit, ita “Armored Shadow” intimire velle.

source: Should we wait for Lumian to return from Morora before summoning Chen Tu again?
target: Exspectamusne ut Lumian ex Morora redeat, antequam Chen Tu iterum evocarer?

source: Franca felt a mix of excitement and apprehension, a state known as “near-home anxiety.”
target: Franca sensit mixturam excitationis et timoris, statum notum ut “angor prope domum.”

source: After a moment, she exhaled slowly, deciding to respond to Amandina on Lumian’s behalf.
target: Post paulum, lente exhalavit et decrevit pro Lumian, Amandinae respondeat.

source: Hmm, Lumian promised to take Amandina to the area around the Samaritan Woman’s Spring, giving her a chance to meet the Underworld Daoist outside of the Dream Festival.
target: Hmm, Lumian pollicitus est Amandinam ad aream circa Fons Feminae Samaritanae ducere, ita ei occasionem praebens ut Daoistam Inferorum extra Festum Somniorum conveniret.

source: This is beneficial for us, but it’s too dangerous with my current strength.
target: Hoc nobis utile est, sed cum mea vi praesenti nimis periculosum videtur.

source: Besides, I’m not sure if the power brought by The Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings combined with the Tarot Club’s Minor Arcana identity can penetrate the fog around the Samaritan Woman’s Spring.
target: Praeterea, non certo mihi videtur an potentia a “Celestial Worthy of Heaven and Earth for Blessings” missa, cum identitate Minor Arcana “Tarot Club”, nebulae circa Fons Feminae Samaritanae penetrare valeat.

source: We should wait until Lumian is out of Morora.
target: Exspectandum est donec Lumian e Morora discedat.

source: For now, I’ll show Amandina some goodwill to lay the groundwork for future cooperation…
target: Nunc autem, Amandinae benevolentiam ostendam, ut fundamenta futurae cooperationis ponantur…

source: Hmm, I’ll organize some important mysticism knowledge and give it to Amandina for free.
target: Hmm, aliquam scientiam mysticam momenti disponam et Amandinae gratis tradam.

source: Show some respect for the higher authority, if not for me.
target: Ostende reverentiam erga maiorem auctoritatem, si non pro me.

source: If the Underworld Daoist sees how well I treat His disciple, maybe His attitude will change…
target: Si Daoista Inferorum perspiciet quam bene discipulum Suum tractem, fortasse eius habitus mutabitur…

source: Also, I’ll ask Amandina which path of the divine she wants to take besides the power of the boons and help her get the corresponding potion formulas and materials.
target: Praeterea, Amandinae rogabo qua viam divinam, praeter vim beneficiorum, sequi velit, atque adiuvabo eam ut formulæ potionum et materias congruentes recipiat.

source: This won’t be free.
target: Hoc non gratis erit.

source: Giving everything for free would make us look too humble and lead to disrespect.
target: Omnia gratis dare nos nimis humiles ostendere faceret et ad contemptum ducere posset.

source: Too much kindness can turn into resentment…
target: Nimis clementia in rancorem vertere potest…

source: Amandina should choose between the paths of Darkness, Death, and Warrior.
target: Amandina inter viās Tenebrarum, Mortis, et Bellatoris eligere debet.

source: The potion formulas and characteristics for the mid-to-low Sequences of the Warrior path are relatively easy to find.
target: Formulae potionum et proprietates sequentiarum mediocris in via Bellatoris relativè facile inveniuntur.

source: Maybe we can ask Madam Justice to get help from Mr. Star for the Darkness path.
target: Fortasse rogare possumus Domina Iustitia ut a Domino Stella auxilium pro via Tenebrarum obtineat.

source: He seems to be a high-ranking member of the Evernight Goddess Church; last time, he wore red gloves…
target: Videtur esse membrum altus ordinis Ecclesiae Deae Perpetuae Noctis; novissima vice chirothecas rubras gerebat…

source: Perfect timing, I was about to report the secrets of the Demoness Sect taught by the Demoness of Black and mention Amandina’s situation to see what mysticism knowledge can be shared and what can’t be leaked…
target: Optime situatus, iam paratus eram enarrare arcana Sectae Demonum, ab Demonessa Nigra tradita, atque de condicione Amandinae referre, ut intuerer quid scientiae mysticae communicari possit et quid divulgari non debeat…

source: Having sorted her thoughts, Franca returned to her bedroom, sat at her desk, and began writing her report.
target: Cogitationibus ordinatis, Franca cubiculum suum rediit, ad scrinium consedit, atque relationem scribere coepit.

source: South Continent, Port Port Pylos of Matani, in a three‐story white marble villa.
target: Continens Meridionalis, Port Port Pylos Matani, in villa marmorā albae tribus tabulis constituta.

source: Having finally made up her mind and sent out that letter, Amandina grew more awake as the night went on, pacing back and forth in her soft, girlish bedroom, waiting for Lumian’s reply.
target: Postquam tandem animum constituens et epistulam misit, Amandina, cum nox procederet, vigilantior facta est, in cubiculo suo tenero puellarum simili circuitum faciens, responsum Lumiani exspectans.

source: The more she learned about mysticism and Beyonders, the more she realized the gap between herself and Lumian and how ignorant she had been.
target: Quo magis de mystica et Beyonder discere coepit, eo magis animadvertit discrimen inter se et Lumian atque quantum olim ignorasse se.

source: Though she felt she could continue living as she had, maintaining the appearance of a normal high-society person with certain supernatural abilities, the events during the Dream Festival and the rumors she had heard from various mysticism circles made her feel a sense of crisis and urgency.
target: Etsi putabat se posse vivere ut antea, personam honestae alti societatis cum nonnullis facultatibus supernaturalibus servans, eventus Festi Somniorum ac rumores ex variis circulis mysticarum in animo habere crisis et urgentiam facere.

source: Living in the South Continent in an era of increasing disasters, her Sequence 7 Nightmare powers and current situation of facing everything alone made her truly afraid that one day her entire family would become sacrifices in a Rose School of Thought blood ritual or that the hidden problems of the Dream Festival would suddenly erupt and engulf her.
target: Vivens in Continenti Meridionali in tempore calamitatum crescentium, potentia eius Sequenciae VII “Nightmare” et solitaria adversus omnia pugnandi condicio eam vere terruerunt ne aliquando omnis familia eius in sacrificia ritu sanguineo Scholae Rosi converteretur aut ne problemata occulta Festi Somniorum subito eruptura eam opprimerent.

source: The more she knew, the more afraid she became.
target: Quo plura scivit, eo magis timida facta est.

source: Amandina felt she could never return to her previous state of ignorance and recklessness, and she had a strong desire for higher Sequences and more extraordinary power.
target: Amandina sensit se numquam redire posse ad pristinam ignorantiam et imprudentiam, atque vehementer desiderabat superiores sequentias et potentiam extraordinariam.

source: That would mean she could do more and see more.
target: Id significaret se plura efficere atque plura videre posse.

source: Suddenly, she saw the same cool-looking charred messenger from before emerge from the void, handing her a small dressing mirror.
target: Subito, vidit eundem nuntium exustum, qui antea apparuerat, e vacuo emergere et ei parvum speculum ad ornandum tradere.

source: A mirror? What does Lumian Lee mean by giving me a mirror?
target: Speculum? Quid significat Lumian Lee mihi speculum dare?

source: Amandina accepted the mirror with curiosity and confusion, feeling it was quite ordinary.
target: Amandina speculum cum curiositate et perplexitate accepit, sentiens illud esse prorsus commune.

source: She was about to ask the Penitent Baynfel when she noticed a dark, aqueous light spreading across the mirror’s surface.
target: Iam paene Penitentem Baynfel interrogare volebat, cum animadvertit lucem obscuram atque aquosam per superficiem speculi diffundere.

source: As the light flowed, the mirror gradually brightened, revealing a figure.
target: Dum lux diffuse fluebat, speculum paulatim illuminatum est, figuram revelans.

source: A mystic telegraph? And one where you can see and talk to the other person? How fascinating…
target: Telegraphum mysticum? Et unum quo alterum videre ac loqui possis? Quam mirabile…

source: Amandina didn’t notice the messenger leaving, her attention entirely captivated by the mirror.
target: Amandina nuntium discedentem non animadvertit, tota sua attentio in speculo captata.

source: She soon realized that the figure in the mirror wasn’t Lumian Lee but a stranger, a woman.
target: Mox intellexit figuram in speculo non esse Lumian Lee, sed ignotam, feminam.

source: The woman had lake-colored eyes, both bright and deep, as if hiding countless words that made one want to explore them.
target: Femina oculos habebat colore lacustri, claros atque profundos, quasi innumeras verba celaret, quae explorari concupiscantur.

source: Her nose was delicate and straight, her lips a tempting combination of red and tender white skin, and her eyebrows extended to her temples, with her flaxen hair tied into a ponytail, giving her an air of elegance.
target: Naris eius delicata et recta erat, labia delectabilis mixtione rubro et tenera albo formata, et supercilii ad tempora se extendebant, dum capilli flavi in caudam nodati essent, quae indolem elegantiae afferebant.

source: So beautiful… Amandina stared blankly, instinctively admiring the woman in her mind.
target: Quam pulchra… Amandina vacuo aspectu intuebatur, instinctive feminam in animo suo admirans.

source: She herself was a girl of outstanding appearance and had always been proud of it, but this time, she felt no sense of competition, entirely immersed in a beauty she had never seen before.
target: Ipsa puella eminenti specie praedita fuit et semper de ea superba, sed hoc tempore nullum sensum certaminis sensit, penitus in pulchritudine immersa quam nunquam antea viderat.

source: Her gaze naturally lowered, seeing the smooth, slender neck and the lace flowers around the shirt collar.
target: Aspectus eius naturaliter deorsum cecidit, videns collum lenem et tenuem atque ornamenta linearia quasi flores circa margines vestis.

source: For some reason, Amandina felt an urge to see the entire body of the woman in the mirror, to see how beautiful she would look naked.
target: Aliqua ratione, Amandina sensit desiderium totum corpus feminae in speculo intuendi, ut perspiceret quam pulchra nuda appareret.

source: She felt this wasn’t her own problem.
target: Sentiit hoc non esse suum proprium problema.

source: Even Padre Cali who only liked men would surely have a similar urge!
target: Etiam Padre Cali, qui solum viros amabat, certe talem cupiditatem haberet!

source: Using a bit of Charm to enhance goodwill for easier communication, Franca also observed Amandina.
target: Ut parvulo Charme benevolentiam augeret, ad communicationem faciliorem perficiendam, Franca etiam Amandinam contemplata est.

source: This girl had a waterfall of black hair and blue eyes, exuding a youthful energy of free self-expression.
target: Haec puella habebat capsulas nigras quasi cataractam et oculos caeruleos, iuvenem vim liberam suam exprimens.

source: All of Lumian’s female acquaintances are quite beautiful… Is this a Hunter’s talent?
target: Omnes cognatae femines Lumiani pulcherrimae sunt… Num hoc ingenium Venatoris sit?

source: Franca smiled sweetly through the glass mirror.
target: Franca per speculum vitrei leniter subridebat.

source: “Lumian is busy right now and can’t leave, so he asked me to communicate with you.”
target: “Lumian nunc occupatus est nec discedere potest, itaque me rogavit ut tecum communicarem.”

source: Amandina snapped out of her daze, shaking off the spell of the woman’s beauty.
target: Amandina ex stupore suo evasit, incantamentum pulchritudinis feminae dimittens.

source: She looked at Franca in the mirror, curiosity and a desire to explore igniting within her.
target: In speculo Francam contemnit, cum curiositate et explorandi cupiditate interius accensa.

source: “You’re Lumian… Eh… Monsieur Lumian Lee’s friend? The one who might need my help in the future?”
target: “Tu es Lumian… Eh… amicus Domini Lumian Lee? Ille qui fortasse auxilium meum in futurum petet?”

source: “Yes.” Franca smiled and nodded.
target: “Ita.” Franca subridens annuit.

source: Hmph, and you say you’re not lovers.
target: Hemph, et dicis vos non esse amantes.

source: Such a beautiful woman makes even me, who likes men, want to sleep with her.
target: Talis pulchra femina efficit ut etiam ego, qui viros amo, cupiam cum ea iacere.

source: How much more for a man who doesn’t like men… Amandina felt she had seen through Lumian’s lie.
target: Quanto magis pro viro qui viros non amat… Amandina sensit se mentis Lumiani penitus perspexisse.

source: She straightened her waterfall-like hair and asked brightly, “I’m willing to help you. Can you keep your promise?”
target: Capillos quasi cataractam nigrorum ornatos ordinavit et clare rogavit: “Paratus sum te adiuvare. Potesne promissionem tuam servare?”

source: “That might have to wait until Lumian finishes his current tasks, and you’re not strong enough yet,” Franca said succinctly.
target: “Forsitan id exspectare debeat donec Lumian negotia sua currentia conficiat, et tu nondum satis fortis sis,” Franca succincte dixit.

source: “Do you want to advance through potions besides the power of boons?
target: “Visne per potionibus progredi, praeter vim beneficiorum?

source: Which path do you want: Death, Darkness, or Warrior?”
target: Quae viam vis eligere: Mortem, Tenebras, aut Bellatorem?”

source: Franca spoke quickly because the power of the Ice Amulet was limited in time.
target: Franca celeriter locuta est, quia potentia Amuletis Glacialis temporarie finita erat.

source: After posing the question, she suddenly thought of something.
target: Postquam quaestionem posuit, subito aliquid in mentem venit.

source: It is said that the Warrior path’s potions has a significant height-enhancing effect, even turning the drinker into a giant at higher levels…
target: Dicitur potiones viae Bellatoris effectum notabilem in altitudine augendi habere, et etiam potum in gradus superiores in gigantem convertere…

source: Hmm, turning such a pretty girl into a three or four-meter-tall giant beauty seems odd…
target: Hmm, puellam tam pulchram in gigantem trium vel quattuor metrorum altum transformare insolitum videtur…

source: Franca wasn’t sure if she was worried or looking forward to it.
target: Franca non certe sciebat num id timueret an exspectaret.

source: Amandina had discussed with Lumian which paths she could take and had thought seriously about it, so she quickly made her decision.
target: Amandina cum Lumiano de viis sequi possset disseruerat et serio de ea cogitaverat, itaque celeriter decrevit.

source: “Darkness.”
target: “Tenebras.”

source: As a girl who had always been good at understanding her parents’ thoughts and was adored by her elders, Amandina felt that since the figure during the Dream Festival had only given her the power of Darkness and not the Death power given to Robert or the Warrior power given to some gravekeepers, it might mean that He wanted her to be pure and focus on the path of Darkness.
target: Ut puella semper in cogitationibus parentum suorum bene percepta atque ab senioribus carissima, Amandina sensit, quia figura in Festo Somniorum solum vim Tenebrarum ei dederit, nec vim Mortis quae Roberto, aut vim Bellatoris quae quibusdam custodianis sepulchrorum tribuata esset, id fortasse significare voluisse, ut puram esse et in viam Tenebrarum incumbere concupieret.

source: She also planned to go to the ancient tomb during the next Dream Festival to receive more gifts, naturally not wanting to disappoint that figure.
target: Praeterea, consilium ceperat ad tumulum antiquum ire durante proximo Festo Somniorum, ut dona plura acciperet, naturale nolens illam figuram deludere.

source: I still want to see what happens when the power of the Death or Warrior path is mixed with the Darkness boon…
target: Adhuc cupio videre quid fiat, cum virtus viæ Mortis aut Bellatoris cum dono Tenebrarum misceatur…

source: Franca said seriously, “I will inquire and gather the necessary things for you, but you need to pay for it or complete tasks I assign.”
target: Franca serio dixit, “Quaesiam et colligam ea quae tibi necessaria sunt, sed solvere aut officia quae tibi assignabo exsequere debes.”

source: Amandina was no longer the naive girl she used to be and understood the value of potion formulas and Beyonder ingredients.
target: Amandina iam non erat puella ingenua quam olim fuisset et intellexit pretium formularum potionum atque ingredientorum Beyonder.

source: She nodded.
target: Annuit.

source: “Okay.”
target: “Ita.”

source: Franca smiled in the mirror.
target: Franca in speculo subridebat.

source: “Also, I appreciate you agreeing to help. No matter what Lumian promised you, I will provide you with some extra mysticism knowledge for free.”
target: “Praeterea, gratum mihi est quod adiuvare consensisti; quocumque Lumian tibi promiserit, ego tibi scientiam mysticam additam gratis praestabo.”

source: “Really?” Amandina was delighted.
target: “Vere?” Amandina delectata est.

source: This beautiful lady is truly generous!
target: Haec pulchra domina vere liberalis est!

source: And it’s not a trap.
target: Et id non est insidiosum.

source: The potion formulas and Beyonder ingredients come at a cost.
target: Formulae potionum et ingredienta Beyonder certo pretio veniunt.

source: Franca didn’t answer directly but smiled and said, “Remember, my name is Franca.”
target: Franca non directe respondit sed subridens dixit, “Memento nomen meum esse Franca.”

source: As she spoke, she raised her right hand and pushed a stack of stapled papers forward.
target: Dum loquebatur, dexteram manum levavit et fasciculum chartarum confixarum protulit.

source: In Amandina’s eyes, the stack grew larger, eventually penetrating the glass and falling into her hands, while Franca’s image disappeared from the mirror.
target: In oculis Amandinae, fasciculus magisque crevit, denique vitrum perveniens in manus eius cecidit, dum imago Francae ex speculo evanuit.

source: Franca… Lumian Lee and she make a good match…
target: Franca… Lumian Lee et illa bene conveniunt…

source: Amandina imagined Lumian and Franca together, suddenly having some romantic thoughts.
target: Amandina Lumian et Francam simul imaginavit, subito nonnullas cogitationes amorosas excipiens.

source: She whispered to herself, That must be beautiful. I’d love to see it…
target: Sibi susurravit: “Pulchrum certe erit. Vellem id videre…”

source: Suppressing the images in her mind, Amandina looked at the papers in her hand, glancing over a line of words: “Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence…”
target: Mentis imagines reprimens, Amandina chartas in manu intuens una lineam verborum legit: “Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence…”

source: Wh- Amandina was both bewildered and deeply impressed.
target: Quid— Amandina perplexa erat atque vehementer admirata.

source: Morora, late night.
target: Morora, in nocte serotina.

source: After the Carnivore bar closed, Lumian exited through the back door and saw Gusain wearing a top silk hat.
target: Postquam taberna Carnivora clausum est, Lumian per ostium posticum exiit et Gusainum, galeam sericam praetendentem, conspexit.

source: Gusain slowly smiled.
target: Gusain lente subridit.

source: “I’ll take you to the place for your test now.”
target: “Te nunc ad locum probationis tuae ducam.”
